actions.oldValue: When you're stuck between the devil and the deep blue sea, the deep blue sea can sometimes look very inviting. In this powerful drama of passion versus loyalty, Hester Collyer, the daughter of a clergyman and wife of a judge is floundering in the closing stages of a hopeless affair. She won the Olivier for Best Actress in 2007 for Much Ado About Nothing and has been nominated for The Little Dog Laughed and Women on the Verge of a Breakdown.
actions.newValue: Terence Rattigan's 1952 drama. In a London flat, Hester Collyer, the daughter of a clergyman and wife of a High Court judge, is found after a failed suicide attempt, at the end of a hopeless affair with former RAF pilot Freddie Page. Over one day she weighs passion against loyalty and what is left to live for.
actions.description: the-deep-blue-sea-west-end-2025: synopsis: drop an actor biography sentence; describe the play (londonboxoffice.co.uk tamsin-greig-the-deep-blue-sea-west-end)

actions.oldValue: Together, the expert cast tells the story of the happily married couple, Polly and Nick, who seem to have it all—they have two children and successful careers. However, they're missing a bit of sparkle.
actions.newValue: Mike Bartlett's comedy. Polly and Nick seem to have it all, with two children and successful careers, but the marriage has lost its sparkle. When Polly's student Kate enters their lives, the three of them start to test what a relationship can be.
actions.description: unicorn-west-end-2025: synopsis: drop a marketing fragment and add the third character (westendbestfriend.co.uk unicorn listing)

actions.oldValue: Together, they tell the gripping tale of  Raoul Moat, who was released from Durham Prison on July 1st, 2010. Over only a few short days, a man was murdered, a police officer was blinded, and one woman was left fighting for her life. The manhunt for Moat was one of the largest in all of UK history as he was traced across Northumberland.
actions.newValue: Robert Icke's play about Raoul Moat, released from Durham Prison on 1 July 2010. Within days a man was murdered, a police officer blinded and a woman left fighting for her life, and the hunt for Moat across Northumberland became one of the largest in UK history.
actions.description: manhunt-west-end-2025: synopsis: drop a marketing fragment (londontheatre.co.uk manhunt review)

actions.oldValue: This modern reimagining of the Ibsen classic begins on the evening of July 3rd in the Hamptons. The publishing magnate Elena Solness is tirelessly working to prepare a part for her architect husband, Henry Solness. Things don’t go as planned when a former student of Henry’s, with whom he had a previous sexual relationship, arrives at the party. Throughout this complex love triangle, sexual politics and relationship vulnerabilities are explored.
